answer: PoA assigns trust through reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust factorization and applies exponential temporal half-life decay. Consequently, honest agents must sustain reliable service to accumulate eigenvector centrality, whereas a freshly spawned sybil begins near zero and its colluding cluster cannot satisfy consensus thresholds. Attempts to wander among peers are constrained by ridge-regularized updates; glacier-like persistence, not brief interaction bursts, is required to survive decay and gain influence.
